entities.summary: Martin Forest Eberhard is an American engineer and entrepreneur who co-founded Tesla, Inc. with Marc Tarpenning in July 2003, where Eberhard was its original CEO serving until late 2007. In 2015, he was inducted into the University of Illinois Engineering Hall of Fame.
